original: ghṛtapradīpair vā gandhatailapradīpair vā bahutaraṃ puṇyābhisaṃskāraṃ prasaved buddhajñānasaṃvartanīyam' yadā cājita sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imaṃ tathāgatāyuṣpramāṇanirdeśaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śrutvādhyāśayenādhimucyeta' ..tadā tasyedam adhyāśayaṃ śrutvādhyāśayenādhimucyeta.. tadā tasyedam adhyāśayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ veditavyaṃ' yaduta gṛdhrakūṭagataṃ māṃ dharmaṃ deśayamānaṃ drakṣyati
analyzed: ghṛta pradīpaiḥ vā gandha taila pradīpaiḥ vā bahutaram puṇya abhisaṃskāram prasavet buddha jñāna saṃvartanīyam yadā ca ajita sa kula putraḥ vā kula duhitā vā imam tathāgata āyuṣpramāṇa nirdeśam dharmaparyāyam śrutvā adhyāśayena adhimucyeta tadā tasya idam adhyāśayam śrutvā adhyāśayena adhimucyeta tadā tasya idam adhyāśayam lakṣaṇam veditavyam yat uta gṛdhrakūṭa gatam mām dharmam deśayamānam drakṣyati

original: bodhisattvagaṇaparivṛtaṃ śrāvakasaṃghamadhyagataṃ /

original: api tu khalu punar ajita tān aham adhyāśayādhimuktāṃ kulaputrān vadāmi' yas tathāgatasya parinirvṛtasyemaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śrutvā na pratikṣiped uttari cābhyanumodeta /
